title.en: MALACANANG FOR THE COMPENSATION OF THE CHAIRMAN OF THE SUBIC BAY METROPOLITAN AUTHORITY (SBMA)

text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order, series of 2004 shall heretofore
read as follows:
"The Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Subic Bay Metropolitan
Authority ISBMA] shall be appointed by the President while the SBMA
Administrator shall serve as ex-officio Vice-Chairman of the SBMA Board.
The compensation of the SBMA Chairman as head of agency shall be the
same as that of the Administrator."

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
City of Manila, 30 October 2007
goin A. Aurage
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
